In this video we cover:
Adani Group is planning to invest ₹85,000 crore to build massive data centres across India, with plans to scale from 2 GW to 10 GW. Reliance is also entering the space with its own 1 GW data centre in Jamnagar. But why are India’s top corporates rushing into this space? In this video, we break down the global data centre boom, India’s strategic position, key players, and the challenges like high power use and environmental impact.
